## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All issue-specific requirements are met
- [ ] Correctness and negative-edge cases are tested
- [ ] Shared interfaces conform to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- [ ] Solana authority/finance changes conform to docs/SOLANA_PROTOCOL.md (if applicable)
- [ ] UI conforms to docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md (if applicable)
- [ ] No unreviewed unrelated changes, credentials, seed phrases or personal data

## Review

- [ ] Reviewer examined actual diff and relevant tests
- [ ] P0 findings resolved with regression tests

**No merge from agent prose alone.** The head commit, tests and observations establish readiness.
